radiusSource: Radius 40.7 +/- 1.9 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, CV Mon: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 40.7 +/- 1.9 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 28,314,990 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
